notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI mirrors the main cooldown mechanisms: the GCD starts locally at cast-send from Spell.dbc StartRecoveryCategory/Time, the spell's own recovery + category recovery start when the cast completes, SMSG_SPELL_COOLDOWN is handled as the server override path (including addressed pet lists into the pet store), and the read resolves spell-vs-category with longest-remaining-wins plus the CooldownFrame finish-flash display law. But 5 of 13 tracked opcodes are unhandled and the on-hold record state does not exist.
